turns.question: What share of total non-cancelled order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026 came from the top three customers by revenue, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no share-of-top-customers metric, and I may not compute the percentage myself. The figures it returned for 17 August to 2 October 2026 are: total non-cancelled revenue EUR 19,506.59, and the top three customers by revenue (customer 10 at EUR 2,356.00, customer 2 at EUR 2,331.00, customer 1 at EUR 2,164.95). Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
